name: VideoNoiseWarp (Burgert, full version)
plain: The fuller form of flow-warped noise that core adapts. Extras include degradation, which mixes warp noise with fresh noise by a variance-preserving blend, and temporal interpolation to latent frame count.
math:
After warp: mix_new_noise: n' = (α·ε + (1−α)·n)/√(α²+(1−α)²). Optional: n'·(σ_0−σ_last)/scale_factor.
Core warp as in void-noise-warp; downscale by area and multiply by factor.

props.spectrum: white per frame; correlated along flow
props.normalizes_variance: yes except the optional σ scale

label: from code
surprise: Core's VOID port dropped degradation; this version keeps it.
